name: Selective Conception
description: Full conscious control of fertility; never suffers unwanted pregnancy.

name: Ambidextrous
description: Uses both hands equally well, with no off-hand penalty.

name: Acute Sense
description: One or more senses heightened to superhuman sensitivity.

name: Double-Jointed
description: Extraordinary flexibility, adding dice to relevant Dexterity rolls.

name: Pain Tolerance
description: Shrugs off wound penalties to varying degrees.

name: Large Size
description: Unusually large and heavy, with extra soak.

name: Legendary Attribute
description: May raise one Attribute to 6.

name: Special Resistance
description: Immune or highly resistant to a specific danger such as poison or fire.

name: Special Sense
description: Possesses a sense beyond the normal five.

name: Mutation
description: A beneficial (or harmful) Wyld mutation.

name: Common Sense
description: Sound practical judgment; the Storyteller warns of foolish actions.

name: Internal Compass
description: Uncanny sense of direction; always knows which way is which.

name: Eidetic Recall
description: Near-perfect memory of everything experienced.

name: Prodigy
description: A natural genius at a particular skill or field of knowledge.

name: Virtue Specialty
description: A focused expression of a Virtue that grants extra dice.

name: Driving Passion
description: An all-consuming cause that lends willpower to its pursuit.

name: Tactical Instincts
description: An intuitive grasp of battlefield strategy and tactics.

name: True Love
description: A deep, mutual love that lends strength in adversity.

name: True Paragon
description: Embodies a Virtue so purely it strengthens the character's resolve.

name: Jack of All Trades
description: Broad competence, reducing penalties for unskilled Ability rolls.

name: Born to Rule
description: Natural authority that others instinctively obey.

name: Enchanting Feature
description: A striking, attractive presence that aids Social rolls.

name: Innocuous
description: Unremarkable and easily overlooked; aids Larceny and Stealth.

name: Favor
description: A significant favor owed by (or to) a powerful person.

name: Heirloom
description: Owns a valuable piece of property or heirloom item.

name: Hidden Manse
description: A secret, undocumented Manse.

name: Heir Apparent
description: In line to inherit a Background such as Backing or Influence.

name: Legendary Artifact
description: Owns an artifact of First-Age, world-shaking power.

name: Cache
description: Wealth or resources hidden and stored in various places.

name: Alternative Divination
description: Crudely divines the future by an unusual method.

name: Terrestrial Bloodline
description: Descended from the Dragon-Blooded.

name: Celestial Bloodline
description: Descended from a Celestial Exalt (God-Blooded).

name: Priest
description: A recognized priest of a particular deity or religion.

name: Destiny
description: Marked for a great destiny that providence conspires to fulfil.

name: Lucky
description: Blessed with extraordinary good fortune (extra luck points).

name: Past Lives
description: Recalls fragments of previous incarnations' knowledge.

name: Signature Style
description: A distinctive flair that defines the character's actions.

name: Sworn Brotherhood
description: Bound to others by the Terrestrial Sworn Brothers' Oath (Exalted only).

name: Taint's Warning
description: Senses the presence of Underworld or demonic taint.

name: Legendary Breeding
description: The pinnacle of Dragon-Blooded breeding (Dragon-Blooded only).

name: Prescient Dreamer
description: Receives prophetic dreams and visions.

name: Eternal Vow
description: An oath of supernatural binding power.

name: Daredevil
description: Recklessly brave; the Storyteller eases or waives the Willpower roll to brave danger.

name: Brigid's Heir
description: Descended from Brigid; eases the learning of sorcery.

name: Unusual Appearance
description: A striking or off-putting appearance (odd coloring, scars) that draws notice.

name: Mute
description: Cannot speak or make vocal sounds.

name: Sterile
description: Physically incapable of siring or bearing children.

name: Limited Forms
description: (Lunars) Restricted in the shapes the character can assume.

name: One Eye
description: Has only one eye; a penalty to Awareness and ranged attacks.

name: Sun-Seared
description: Burns horribly in sunlight, taking damage from exposure.

name: Climate Sensitive
description: Suffers in environments different from the one the character is used to.

name: Amputee
description: Missing one or more limbs.

name: Dying
description: Afflicted with a terminal condition that will eventually kill the character.

name: Small
description: Unusually small, with reduced effective Strength for some purposes.

name: Disfigured
description: A wretched deformity that lowers Appearance and Social rolls.

name: Slow Healing
description: Recovers from injury far more slowly than normal.

name: Weak Immune System
description: Far more vulnerable to disease and infection.

name: Diminished Attributes
description: One or more Attributes are below the normal minimum.

name: Diminished Sense
description: One or more senses are dulled or absent.

name: Derangement
description: Suffers a mental derangement such as depression, hysteria, or sadism.

name: Amnesia
description: Large gaps in memory; cannot recall parts of the past.

name: Superstition
description: Beholden to superstitions that constrain the character's actions.

name: Vice
description: A vice the character indulges to their detriment.

name: Addiction
description: Addicted to a substance, suffering withdrawal without it.

name: Callous
description: Forfeits dots of Virtue, hardened against compassion.

name: Nightmares
description: Plagued by horrific dreams that cost Willpower on waking.

name: Pacifist
description: Refuses to do violence, in general or against a particular target.

name: Unskilled
description: Forfeits dots in one or more Abilities.

name: Weak-Willed
description: Forfeits dots of Willpower.

name: Barbarian
description: Raised outside civilization; loses dots from Social Abilities involving city life.

name: Secrets
description: Harbors a dangerous secret others wish to learn.

name: Disciple
description: Bound in service to a master or mentor.

name: Enemy/Rival
description: Has a dangerous enemy or rival who works against the character.

name: Known Anathema
description: (Celestial Exalted) Publicly known as Anathema, hunted by the Realm.

name: Wanted
description: Wanted by the authorities for known crimes.

name: Disturbing
description: Makes others uncomfortable, hindering social interaction.

name: Child
description: Has not reached full maturity; treated as a child.

name: Chimera
description: (Lunars) Warped by the Wyld into a chimera, losing the Renown Background.

name: Damaged Artifact
description: Owns an artifact that is damaged and only partly functional.

name: Debt
description: Owes a significant debt that drains Resources.

name: Unbidden Oracle
description: Involuntarily speaks prophecy at inopportune moments.

name: Dark Fate
description: Doomed by a tragic fate that providence works toward.

name: Greater Curse
description: (Celestial Exalted) Bound by the Great Curse of the character's kind.

name: Unlucky
description: Cursed with persistent bad luck.

name: Permanent Caste Mark
description: (Celestial Exalted) The Caste Mark is always visible, marking the character as Anathema.

name: Beacon of Power
description: (Exalted) Radiates Essence that draws attention and disrupts subtle magic.

name: Weak Essence
description: Possesses unusually weak Essence, with a smaller mote pool.

name: Death-Taint
description: (Abyssals/Ghosts) Tainted by the Underworld, harmed by life-aspected things.

name: Throwback
description: (Celestial Exalted) Possessed by the Nature of a past incarnation's Essence.
